question: Can one predeclared A issuer-session attempt be discovered/reviewed in time, source-bound, and priced through every unchanged possible exit with whole shares and frozen costs?
notAnswered: IG1 data usability as A validation

policy.exitContract: PROPOSED ONLY: max 5 sessions; close below opening low exits next session open
policy.invalidationContract: PROPOSED ONLY: close below opening low; no intraday stop or target

enrollment.selection: Freeze one stable security/CIK from existing approved research universe before disclosure; preserve original valid owner decision; never choose by later gains. First chronological pre-open8-K observation in the declared window; primary inspection may reject it. No replacement document/candidate/session.
enrollment.interpretation: Operational calibration only; restricted issuer/window never becomes the economic-pilot population or untouched confirmation.
enrollment.preparation: One prior-close preparation boundary, before the selected disclosure; if original cap cannot actually precede disclosure, stop.
enrollment.entryObservation: Full declared regular entry session; no15:00 cutoff substituted for16:00/early close. Continuous bar discovery contract still requires implementation/review.
enrollment.datesRule: Exact prior preparation, entry and every possible exit session must be filled from reviewed calendar after prerequisites/review; no automatic rescheduling.
enrollment.noEvent: INCONCLUSIVE; no extension, replacement, promoted research lead or forced signal.

comparisons.singleAttempt: No edge/mean-excess claim. Report both comparison statuses NOT_EVALUATED unless genuine predeclared control evidence exists; never substitute SPY.

pilotBounds.counting: Count first 30 unique issuer-session eligible paper entries in chronological trigger order; stable security ID breaks timestamp ties. Missing outcomes count against the sample and are never replaced. Log all attempted candidates and rejections.
pilotBounds.enrollmentEnd: Whichever is earlier: thirtieth eligible entry, or the last entry session whose full five-session exit runout fits inside day60 using the reviewed authoritative exchange calendar.
pilotBounds.hardFinish: Day60 inclusive. Resolve remaining outcomes from already authorized observations; missing or unrecoverable outcomes remain UNKNOWN. No automatic extension.
pilotBounds.capabilityCalibration: Offline/synthetic and any separately approved calibration must precede final freeze and cannot be pooled with untouched pilot outcomes.
pilotBounds.fixedCalendarAndRiskSet: Exact dates, security universe, candidate source/risk set, data endpoints and mandatory request/storage/retention caps must be filled and independently reviewed before approval; 60 days alone is not a sufficient acquisition bound.

notes: These are ceilings for independent review, not implemented whole-scope enforcement or execution approval.
64GET includes reference preparation, discovery, identity, bars, quotes and closes; not64plus preparation.
Up to12WS upgrades are additional to64GET. Authentication/subscription wire frames and bytes must also be counted; no reconnect.
The32custody/control-plane HTTP pool is separate, not an unlimited SDK retry allowance.
The128MiB global raw ceiling is lower than existing184MiB engineering worst-case before inputs; quota exhaustion stops, never silently expands. Existing per-store16MiB/2000file caps remain.
New routes/stream mode and exact polling timestamps remain unimplemented/unreviewed; cannot issue execution request with blank schedule/identity/hosts.
No raw vendor data in public git, CI logs, model inputs or Telegram. Retention/licensing, encryption, deletion/backup limits require review.
No purchase/overage; no run without verified existing private capacity/quota and cost controls.
proposedCeilingsNotPermissions.retentionAnchor: 3days after final recovery/report; collection/runout period additionally retained only under accepted terms

closeAndExit: Same frozen five-session/earlier daily-close invalidation→next-open rule. All5close slots and4next-open plus1final-preclose BBO slots retained, even following an earlier modeled exit. No presumed stop/auction fill; selected quote cannot be replaced by later better quote.

engineering.why: No genuine turnover/availability/independent feed evidence means no authentic admission regardless of plumbing.
engineering.test: Applicable turnover constituents/corrections, actual pre-event cap route, quote conditions/units/feed rights, two independent SIP channels, private custody identified; original-based positive and adverse cases pass existing strict caller or gate ends NOT_FEASIBLE/INCONCLUSIVE.

engineering.why: Timely bar trigger and every possible exit must reach strict importer before their deadlines.
engineering.test: Existing actual host uses bounded native bar/quote/close ports; late/empty/adverse/missing/halt/disconnect/correction/early-close inputs remain visible and UNKNOWN where required; no REST backfill counted as timely stream.

engineering.why: One in-process pair/signatures cannot establish independent source capture or timely review/owner state.
engineering.test: Independent existing role contexts with immutable merge; original clocks; wrong/reused authority, late review, worker death and concurrent recovery tested through caller; producer continues while downstream waits.

engineering.why: Existing32/64HTTP and per-window caps do not include producer, stream, reference preparation, shared disk or custody transport.
engineering.test: Extend existing fenced reservations/guards only; failed/unknown attempts count; restarts/roles cannot renew global budget; refuse before network or write on exhaustion/unsafe state.

engineering.why: The question requires one original-bound chain and recoverable all-case report, not separately passing modules.
engineering.test: Actual producer→ports→original stores→source-derived decision→strict card→all possible exits→selected quoted economics→encrypted export/recovery; independent-process crashes at new boundaries; all originals/losses/missingness preserved. Exact independent review and full hosted logs.

effort.condition: S1 first, at most12focused hours; if no supported unchanged input/independent source exists, stop instead of building remaining28–42hours.

verdicts.FEASIBLE: Authentic original-bound timely case with all mandatory source/role/window/custody evidence and defensible whole-share quote model; means operational feasibility only, never profitability/edge/pilot adoption.
verdicts.NOT_FEASIBLE: A mandatory unchanged input/permission/contract demonstrably cannot be supported in the reviewed scope. Name the reason; not evidence of a losing strategy.
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: Operational case: no eligible event/trigger, missing or unbounded mandatory source/role/entry/exit/custody evidence, unavailable exit, or technical interruption. Both comparisons may remain NOT_EVALUATED for this operational question only; the economic pilot remains INCONCLUSIVE without its mandatory control evidence.

approvalPrerequisites: Exact independent reviewed final code/manifest/workflow/fixture hashes
Verified source contracts and concurrency without buying/upgrading
Concrete existing private hosts/operators/bindings and custody/recovery evidence, no secret values
Named available operator; exact one-run action; recovery/shutdown/refusal rules
